title: mandevilla luetzelburgii
intro: Mandevilla luetzelburgii, commonly known as the Chilean jasmine, is a flowering vine plant native to South America. This plant is known for its fragrant and attractive white flowers, which have been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. Research has shown that the Chilean jasmine has several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Mandevilla luetzelburgii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedation, anxiolysis, and improved sleep quality.
